from datadog_api_client.v2 import ApiClient, Configuration
from datadog_api_client.v2.api import metrics_api
from datadog_api_client.v2.model.metric_aggregate_request import MetricAggregateRequest
from datadog_api_client.v2.model.metric_compute import MetricCompute
from datadog_api_client.v2.model.metric_filter import MetricFilter

def aggregate_metric_stats(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    # DD_API_KEY and DD_APP_KEY must be in environment variables
    configuration = Configuration()
    api_client = ApiClient(configuration)
    api_instance = metrics_api.MetricsApi(api_client)

    metric_name = payload["metric_name"]

    body = MetricAggregateRequest(
        compute=MetricCompute(
            aggregation_type=payload["aggregator"],
        ),
        filter=MetricFilter(
            _from=payload["from_timestamp"],
            to=payload["to_timestamp"],
            query=payload.get("query"),
        ),
    )
    result = api_instance.aggregate_metrics(metric_name=metric_name, body=body)
    return result
